_comment: PIB -> matični broj (MB) for IŽS suppliers that the Firme agents check. The Portal javnih nabavki has PIB only and the APR open data has MB only, so the pairs were matched by name and only confident matches are listed (same core name + same legal form/municipality where the portal gives it, a single plausible APR candidate, or the PIB-MB pair published by Integrity Watch). Everything else stays unmapped: the tool then says 'nije pouzdano pronađen u APR'. Verify before quoting.
